iterations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / infographic-diagram.
Create a NEW polished revision of the Chen Pingan 15-view head-and-shoulders construction sheet, using the input images as explicitly scoped references. Wide 16:9 sheet, target 1920x1080, white background, high-detail crisp readable drawing.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. Existing 15-view sheet: retain its useful 3-row x 5-column educational layout, grayscale clothing, translucent color coded hair masses, pink centerline and eye-line. Its chunky three-bubble jade ornament is WRONG and must be replaced. Its middle columns have insufficient turning differences; improve them.
2. cpa_face_standard_01: PRIMARY facial identity and natural black-haired hairstyle reference. Preserve the exact same grounded 20–22-year-old man: narrow long face, restrained small brown eyes, natural straight brows, lean jaw, slim closed lips, calm steadfast expression, modest tied topknot, loose short side locks. Never borrow the faces from images 3 or 4.
3. Chen Pingan animation still: primary jade color and restrained curled jade ornament reference ONLY. Do not copy the 3D rendering, face, outfit, lighting or bun.
4. Li Xisheng frontal animation still: supporting reference ONLY for the slender scholarly jade pin, delicate curved openwork head, small translucent green material and fine tapered plain tail. Do not copy his face, long loose hairstyle, crown or ornate costume.
5. Clothing reference: preserve Chen Pingan's plain gray-blue outer robe and white crossed inner collar, simplified to chest-up. No need for backpack or waist accessories because they are outside this sheet's study area.

COMPOSITION:
Exactly FIFTEEN comparable busts, 3 rows x 5 columns, numbered 01 through 15 in reading order. Left-to-right columns: left-facing true profile 90 degrees, near-profile 65 degrees, clear three-quarter 45 degrees, subtle turn 20 degrees, frontal 0 degrees. 65-degree views must show much less far eye and narrower far cheek than 45-degree views. The leftmost three heads must truly have profile silhouette and only one visible eye, even in the pitched camera views.
Rows: low camera looking up approx 20 degrees, eye-level camera, high camera looking down approx 20 degrees. Strongly readable differences in skull-top visibility, ear level, underside of jaw, face centerline and eye-line curvature. One fixed physical head/hair configuration seen through camera rotation, no changing face, changing bun, changing hair part or changing collar.
Keep all buns and all chins fully inside their cells with generous clearance; thin subtle horizontal separators. Upper header has title on left and a generous jade-pin detail inset on right; bottom narrow horizontal legend. Faces and hair should be large enough for structural inspection, not tiny full bodies.

THE MAIN CORRECTION — JADE PIN:
Replace every bulky cyan bubble/cloud/bead ornament in reference 1. Design one SMALL, refined scholarly jade pin with a flattened delicately carved asymmetric scroll head: an elongated open C-shaped curl transitions into a smaller counter-hook below, airy negative spaces between the curved jade ribs. The head feels like carved jade openwork, not a row of three round beads, not a toy, not an enormous ruyi or dragon sculpture. Soft muted celadon-to-teal green, slightly translucent edges, subtle highlights, thin bevel, no self-illumination. Slender straight single shaft, gradually tapered plain end, restrained scale.
Preserve a compact open scroll motif informed by references 3 and 4. Do not invent complex engraving that the references do not show.
The same pin occupies the SAME rigid attachment at the base of the topknot behind the brown binding cord, transversely across the character's head. In the frontal column the decorative head is on the viewer's LEFT / character's RIGHT, the fine plain tip viewer's right. Central shaft is occluded by the bun.
As the face rotates toward SCREEN LEFT the decorative head travels to the FAR side and becomes progressively obscured. In column 1 the pin is seen almost end-on: full curl head hidden behind bun, no long horizontal rod, only a tiny plain green end or edge within/at the bun base. In column 2 only a very narrow partly obscured green scroll edge appears, NOT a full decorative face. Column 3 shows an oblique compressed partial scroll, column 4 nearly full but subtly foreshortened, column 5 full small head on correct side. Never mirror it to keep it visible. Do not make the jade pin float above the bun or become a crown.
This occlusion progression is mandatory in ALL THREE rows. The high camera row additionally shows the pin's slender upper edge and sensible contact with the bun; low camera sees less crown surface.
The header inset draws the SAME pin enlarged on white, showing its delicate openwork curls, long fine shaft and taper, plus one small edge-view below to make its flat thickness legible. Label the inset "玉簪放大 · 结构推演". Enlarged structure is a drawing interpretation, not an official technical blueprint.

CONSTRUCTION COLORS:
Under translucent overlays, keep visible dark-gray hair contour and strand direction, and the recognizably black-haired man. Thin pink median line continuously tracks forehead, nose, philtrum, chin; a curved pink eye-level guide wraps the skull with correct perspective. Hair block boundaries are thin white/pink contours, not thick scribbles.
Five consistent translucent colors: muted green front hair, periwinkle blue side hair, violet back hair, turquoise nape hair, warm ochre bun. Do not color skin or clothing with these coding fills. Keep hair section memberships and parting stable across all 15 heads.

TEXT, in clean readable Chinese type:
Title: "陈平安 · 15视角结构拆解"
Subtitle: "玉簪修订 · 中线与发块分区"
Column labels: "侧面 90°", "偏侧 65°", "半侧 45°", "微侧 20°", "正面 0°"
Row labels: "仰视", "平视", "俯视"
Numbers 01–15 exactly once each.
Bottom legend: "中线 / 眼线", "前发", "侧发", "后发", "后颈发", "发髻".
Restrained professional character drawing reference, crisp charcoal linework, light natural shading, neutral expression. No signature, watermark, decorative landscape, labels implying exact 3D measurement, extra heads, extra pins, jewelry, crown, chibi anatomy, idol makeover, or copying animation actors' face.

iterations.prompt:

Keep the same character identity, layout, 15 numbered busts, colors, title, legend, clothes and neutral expression. Reference 2 locks Chen Pingan's face, do not copy its old plain pin. Reference 3 is the scholarly jade pin material/openwork reference ONLY, not the person.

PRIMARY PROBLEM: the inset now has refined openwork but the small heads still have the obsolete fat bubble-cloud pin. All heads must use the SAME NEW SMALL OPENWORK HEAD, no three-bead motif.

1. Redraw the pin inset as a slender flattened celadon jade scroll. A single elegant elongated open C curl with a smaller curved lower hook, a clearly open empty center, a plain narrow neck leading into the long fine tapered shaft. Avoid a chain of 3 bulging circular clouds, pearls, balls, or a ruyi club. The jade ribs should be substantially thinner. Keep the "玉簪放大 · 结构推演" text. For the little edge view below it, render the decorated portion EDGE ON as a thin almost straight flattened jade strip; its two-dimensional curl silhouette should NOT be fully visible edge-on. It is one pin shown from two angles, not two different designs.
2. Put that SAME pin into all 15 heads at a modest functional scale. In the frontal cells 05,10,15, replace their three puffy bubble shapes with one SMALL OPEN C hook and a little lower returning hook. Reduce the ornament height 35% from reference 1 and reduce saturated cyan. Viewer left decorative head, viewer right plain tip. Center shaft hidden through bun base behind binding cord. Do NOT replace the existing bun or character hairstyle.
3. Cells 01,06,11 strict profile: remove the horizontal green tip sticking out at SCREEN RIGHT behind the bun. The shaft is END ON, only a tiny plain green edge or dot within the lower bun silhouette is appropriate. Far-side decorative scroll hidden. No visible whole scroll and NO long horizontal shaft on profile.
4. Cells 02,07,12 near profile: pinhead far side mostly hidden, at most a narrow green edge peeking out, plain tail nearly end-on. No identifiable curl silhouette.
5. Cells 03,08,13 half profile: pin scroll oblique and partly hidden, do not show both curls fully; small fine point may be visible on near side.
6. Cells 04,09,14 slight turn: near-frontal small open scroll, mildly foreshortened. Never full old three-cloud head.

ANGLE SEPARATION — only re-project the faces/hair in COLUMN 2 and COLUMN 4:

- COLUMN 3 remains clear45 degree three-quarter.
- COLUMN 1 remains one-eye strict profile. COLUMN 5 remains symmetrical front.

Do not change the identities, hairstyles, binding cord, colors, typography or border positions. Preserve hair zoning overlays and continuous pink facial median/eye guide, updating those guides only where the head's viewpoint changes. Target 1920x1080 landscape and highest crisp detail. Exactly 15 heads, no cropped buns, no added crowns, no extra jewelry. This is an educational 2D character construction reference, not photorealism.
